thread:
sophia: Quick sync — planning retrofit readiness for 'edge-hosting' packaging (customer-managed networks). Goal: deliver MVP features for customers who need deterministic egress: NAT-relay, static-egress pinning, and a short IP-preservation runbook. Can we scope this for the sprint ending Fri?
kevin: +1. Deterministic egress is the #1 field ask. NAT-relay seems lower risk than forcing customers to change their infra. Do we need an SLA on egress stability?
maria: Tech note: we have a relay prototype in repo `relay-v0`. It wires through operator but currently lacks auth + health checks. Hardening estimate = ~2 dev-weeks.
alex: @maria can you drop a short checklist of what "harden" means operationally? Also who owns egress IP assignment—ops or customer?
maria: Checklist: 1) mTLS + JWT auth plugin, 2) readiness/liveness probes & graceful drain, 3) validation for pinned IPs, 4) basic per-tenant tagging for incident triage, 5) tests for NAT hairpinning. Ownership: customers provide IPs; ops owns the relay config + runbooks.
sophia: Tradeoffs: if we skip per-tenant metrics for MVP we save ~3 days. PM preference = prioritize IP stability, a clear fallback, and docs for NetOps.
kevin: Field ask addendum: some air-gapped customers want a local-only relay mode (no upstream). We should at least not block that in the design.
ops-bot: deploy-bot: nightly-build for `relay-v0` succeeded in staging (build 2024-05-06-03:22). Integration tests: basic connectivity OK.
maria: Proposed rollout plan: canary to 2 customers with strict IP whitelists, 72h monitor + health dashboards, and an automated fallback that routes traffic to old egress path if error rate >5%.
alex: Installer dependency: we need a new flag `--egress-ip-pin` and `--egress-mode` with validation. Ops will also need a runbook for revert and emergency ip release.
sophia: Draft acceptance criteria for launch: a) deterministic egress behavior documented and validated, b) canary metrics show no >5% error bump, c) rollback path exercised in staging. Anything missing?
kevin: :thumbsup: Add: customer comms template and on-call ticket SLA for any post-rollout IP changes. I'll draft the template.
maria: Installer snippet for integration tests / config docs:
```
--egress-ip-pin=203.0.113.42
--egress-mode=static   # options: static | natted
```
We'll add validation that IPs belong to allowed ranges and surface helpful error messages.
sophia: Freeze scope for MVP: NAT-relay (auth + probes), installer flags, runbook, one-pager docs, canary plan + comms. Post-MVP backlog: per-tenant metrics, airgap operator bundle, extended regression tests.
kevin: I'll own customer comms + canary checklist. @maria please confirm final dev estimate by EOD tomorrow so we can commit to sprint.
maria: Confirming estimate: ~10 working days (hardening + installer changes + docs + runbook + basic canary automation). If we deprioritize metrics, we can shave 2 days.
sophia: Thanks all. Scheduling a 30m sync Tue 10am to lock milestones and owners. /remind @channel follow-up Tue 10am.
notes: thread contains short, action-oriented product/eng coordination on retrofit readiness for edge-hosting packaging. Messages are in Slack-style with brief replies, a code snippet, and a bot message.
